episodes.title: Che incubo, Charlie Brown
episodes.synopsis: Accusato da Charlie Brown di essere “troppo civilizzato”, Snoopy sogna di essere un cane da slitta lungo la frontiera dell’Alaska.

overview.value: The gang’s all here! Experience the nostalgia and joy of these iconic specials going back more than 50 years. Tag along with Charlie Brown, Snoopy, Linus, Lucy, and their pals for the early days of their antics and adventures.
